title: Dental Materials IV: Main Exam, 9 December 2018
instructions: ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS IN SECTION A AND ANY TWO QUESTIONS IN SECTION B

items.text: Why is an expansion a pre-requisite property of casting in an investment material?
Other than water, name other liquid that may be added to phosphate manipulation.
Gelation temperature of a reversible hydrocolloid is dependent on true factors. Name them.
Give TWO properties of alginate impression materials that makes it the most successful of all impression materials.
Why does ongar ongar impression material include gypsum hardener? Name it and how does it work.
Give FIVE factors that contribute to an increase in hygroscopic expansion.
Give TWO advantages and TWO disadvantages of alginate impression material.

parts.text: Name an investment material that does not require a metal costing ring and explain why the metal ring is not necessary.
Write down the composition of silica bonded investment material.

Discuss the factors that influence the stability of alginate impression material 2. a) Discuss the basic composition of irreversible hydrocolloids. b) Write down the uses of irreversible hydrocolloids. 3. Write in details the composition properties and manipulation of any two ecostomeric impression materials. 4. Discuss the composition, ideal requirements and properties of gypsum bonded investment material.
